scope: Offline plugin verification lifecycle regression; no live model request or fleet deployment

diagnostic.meaning: The main native terminal resource was removed before the verification reply
diagnostic.exitCodeMeaning: Unknown unless the lifecycle event explicitly supplies an integer exit_status; SDK 0.16.0 does not include it

replay.transport: Fake client; no network model transport
replay.cleanup: Both versions stop only their own synthetic verification session
replay.limit: Not a production latency measurement; HTTP and cleanup latency are not modeled

lifecycleCoverage: Exact Pi/Claude main terminal identity; unrelated sessions and auxiliary resources ignored
Descending lifecycle order; newer create cancels stale delete
New terminal generation receives a separate deletion grace period
Late assistant success and structured provider error take precedence
Codex auxiliary terminal deletion does not fail its app-server verification
Deletion present on the first poll remains distinct from own stop_session cleanup
Cleanup failure preserves the earlier terminal diagnostic
Unavailable session status lookup does not discard observed removal
Only explicit numeric exit status is retained; bool, text and invalid numbers rejected
Receipt persistence allowlists diagnostic fields and excludes raw output
